endorsements.name: T. Gwyddon "data" Owen
endorsements.label: Talkers Without Borders: Worldwide Free Speech without an Internet Connection
endorsements.description: What if a globally accessible maritime communications network was co-opted for other than intended use? Our research tool demonstrates how defenders and users of AIS (the Automatic Identification System) might create and detect a covert communications channel that operates without a conventional server or internet connection.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 34
